body:
# Ex 34 · Accessing Elements of Lists

列表下标从 0 开始：`animals[0]` 是第一只。

## 目标
- 用整数下标取元素
- 分清「第 N 个」与「下标 N-1」

## 自检
- [ ] 能正确指出 ordinal vs cardial
- [ ] 试一下负数下标 `animals[-1]`

starterFiles.ex34.py:
animals = ["bear", "python3", "peacock", "kangaroo", "whale", "platypus"]

print("The animal at 0:", animals[0])
print("The 1st animal is at 0 and is a", animals[0])
print("The 2nd animal is at 1 and is a", animals[1])
print("The 3rd animal is at 2 and is a", animals[2])
print("The animal at 3:", animals[3])
print("The 5th animal is at 4 and is a", animals[4])
print("The animal at 2:", animals[2])
print("The 6th animal is at 5 and is a", animals[5])
print("The animal at 4:", animals[4])
print("Last animal via -1:", animals[-1])
